summary: Read a binary tree. Each node stores an integer, and either child may be absent. Record the root value first, then expand the left subtree, then expand the right subtree, and write the integers in that visiting order. Skip a child that is absent. When the tree is only a root, write that single integer. When the tree is empty, write an empty sequence. Every subtree follows this same order.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a level-order node count, using a dot for a missing child.
